new.text: Figure 7.9: UML-model of OS-Application OS-Applications have a state which defines the scope of accessibility of its Operating System objects from other OS-Applications. Each OS-Application is always in one of the following states: • Active and accessible (APPLICATION_ACCESSIBLE): Operating System objects may be accessed from other OS-Applications. This is the default state at startup. • Currently in restart phase ( APPLICATION_RESTARTING). Operating System ob- jects cannot be accessed from other OS-Applications. State is valid until the OS-Application calls AllowAccess. • T erminated and not accessible ( APPLICATION_TERMINATED): Operating Sys- tem objects cannot be accessed from other OS-Applications.
